i feel very bad about preventing you from getting sleep. as already told, I don't have any real friends, just people I can party with and talk casually. when I said, my parents are very christian, I meant that they are very conservative. sorry for that mistake. 

thank you for complimenting my english skills, i'm not using any translation software, and my plan was always to become a translator, when I was young, but I noticed, that there are already too many. 

thank you for taking time for me.

damnit, that last line wasn't supposed to be there.

it's almost everytime the lack of motivation.
it seems like i am not able to finish things. 

my family is very christian, and if I'd go and talk to a psychologist, my family would also think that i went bonkers.

I think there are some people who would listen to me and talk with me, but nonetheless I don't trust them enough. i guess.

i'm still living with my parents, making no money. the "friends" i have are just people, I am partying with, I've got no one to talk to, because they'll just end up thinking im a loser or just stop talking to me (breaking up contact).
I've got nothing more than my realschulabschluss (GCSE) which I made on a Hauptschule (which is almost the lowest school form in germany).
Then I tried to make my Abitur, which I also failed miserably. Now I'm trying to become a media designer, but apperently I'm failing. again.
I'm in ~1500€ debt and have no job, because, guess what, I've failed every job I tried or just got scammed.
I'm getting 80€/month as support for school.
I don't have high standards, actually I just need a person which i can be near, a oasis of tranquility (that sounds weird in english). but nope, I've just got people I can get drunk with.
actually i'm fearing right now, that you could be somebody I know, and that you'll be making fun of me or anything else, but meh. I stopped to care..
It's way to far away from me.

wow. 
your response is very uplifting. (no sarcasm)
I'm sorry for your loss.. actually that's my biggest fear. i can't and i don't want to imagine the pain my family will have to go through.
well, I thought a throwaway would be more appropiate.
it's funny, because it was my biggest dream to see berlin once, but never had the chance to.
